answer: Treat each agent identity like a cell on a coverage ledge, requiring a verified physical-layer fingerprint before it can transmit. A spoofed identity leaves a hollow link budget, so the admission control rejects it when received power and timing advance fail to match the claimed location. Attacker costs scale with forging RF signatures across many devices, though a colluding cluster with real radios can still pass, an ivory tower limit that coverage planning cannot fully close.
